observations: The M365 accessibility tree showed a blank new-chat editor and no attachment chip.
The Add and manage sources menu exposed the Images and files upload command.
The browser file chooser did not become available to the automation after the upload command or a direct file-input click.
The browser upload troubleshooting guidance requires Allow access to file URLs for the ChatGPT browser extension.
A read-only attempt to inspect chrome://extensions was rejected by the browser URL security policy; no workaround was attempted.
required_user_action: Open chrome://extensions, open Details for the ChatGPT browser extension, and enable Allow access to file URLs.
resume_rule: Reconfirm the blank new chat and zero counters, attach only the frozen r5 bundle, enter the frozen submission body, and stop immediately before Send for action-time confirmation.
